about_the_game:
Parkour Pulse is a parkour-focused simulation game for PC that lets players seamlessly switch between first- and third-person perspectives to explore vibrant, neon-lit environments. Master fluid movement mechanics like wall-running, vaulting, ledge climbing, sliding, and more—designed to offer freedom, creativity, and immersive traversal.

Navigate a series of handcrafted levels where precision, momentum, and mastery of parkour skills are the keys to progression. Engage in light combat with a sci-fi energy pistol to disable simple enemies like drones, adding an extra layer of challenge without breaking the flow of movement.

This version delivers the core parkour experience, focusing on responsive controls, clean mechanics, and expressive traversal. Future updates will expand the game with new levels, improved animations, additional hazards, abilities, challenges, customization options, and quality-of-life improvements.

content_descriptors.notes: Parkour Pulse contains mild combat violence and depictions of enemy death. Players can eliminate enemies using futuristic weapons like energy pistols, and may encounter environmental hazards such as electrified floors, laser traps, and fall damage that can result in character death. There is no gore, dismemberment, or strong language.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060Ti / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card

short_description: Master advanced parkour moves to navigate challenging levels filled with dynamic obstacles and enemies. Utilize special abilities like time manipulation and cloning to solve puzzles and objectives. Progress through levels, earn rewards, and upgrade your skills to unlock new gameplay in the future.
